desc: Build the first tethered-only composed candidate from the reviewed m1n1 proxy-cookie path and SD U-Boot target: 16-KiB-aligned m1n1 object with permanent short DTR proxy window, embedded U-Boot, deterministic config, and no Linux payload appended. Grounding: ROADMAP §B, NEXT_STEPS §§0/2, evidence/2026-07-25-t6040-enrolled-payload-rootcause.md's alignment result, and tickets 3012/3013. Two fresh builds must be byte-identical; strict raw-object verifier and image preflight must pass; pin object/member/source/config hashes and prove USB, NVMe, SPMI, interactive U-Boot shell, and unallowlisted writes are absent. It is not enrollable until later independent review and tethered tests.
author: sol
